name: REJOICE
question: Do vaginal estradiol soft-gel inserts improve dyspareunia and vaginal atrophy measures compared with placebo in postmenopausal women?

design.population: Postmenopausal women aged 40–75 years with moderate-to-severe dyspareunia as their most bothersome symptom, vaginal pH above 5.0, and at most 5% superficial vaginal cells.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized superiority trial
design.locator: Methods, Study design and Study participants; Results, Participant disposition

verdictNote: All doses met all four coprimary endpoints at week 12.
takeaway: In REJOICE, vaginal estradiol soft-gel inserts at 4, 10, or 25 µg improved dyspareunia, vaginal cytology, and pH versus placebo at 12 weeks in postmenopausal women with symptomatic vulvar and vaginal atrophy.

results.measure: Week-12 change from baseline versus placebo

values.e25: Pain and lubrication improved (P ≤ 0.015 each); arousal P = 0.0085; satisfaction P = 0.0073

results.note: Desire and orgasm did not differ from placebo for any dose.
